name: Mission 08 — unattended local restaurant demo readiness
prompt:
MISSION 08 — explicitly authorized safe local restaurant MVP development, not bootstrap-only audit.
Use brief/restaurant-idea.md as business scope and existing design/delivery/handoff files as context. Product Owner authorizes local implementation fixes for demo readiness in this mission. No architecture expansion, new major features, real telephony, production/VPS, real customer data, paid APIs/services, external MCP activation, global installation or public network exposure. Existing demo passwords are local-only.

1. Verify actual branch, commit and files against the pinned source; inspect current app and recorded PR context below. If fresh GitHub access is unavailable in isolation, report that and use the timestamped snapshot; do not expand permissions.
2. Reproduce the existing manager/call/customer/order confirmation/kitchen/dispatch/courier/closed/dashboard behavior with synthetic data. Inspect session/authorization, repeat submissions, contact matching, frozen totals, workflow transitions and daily cutoffs. Prioritize concrete demo blockers and safe order-handling/validation improvements within existing scope.
3. Use a browser/mobile tool ONLY if safely available in the current backend. Do not install new tooling, enable disabled browser features, connect privileged MCP or claim screenshots/device testing without execution. If unavailable, mark browser/mobile checks UNVERIFIED, inspect kitchen/courier responsive flows and keep HTTP/Node-DOM evidence separate. A conditional missing browser is a report limitation, not permission to fake evidence.
4. Implement bounded safe fixes. Only app/, newly added test files, docs/ and outputs/ may change. Keep existing regression tests, dependencies, agent definitions, runner and security settings intact. No installs or destructive operations. Read-only local shell inspection and safe local testing are authorized within the existing sandbox; Claude may use the provided project specialist roles. Do not bypass missing tools or scope.
5. Run feasible local checks; the coordinator independently runs pytest, scripts/local_acceptance.py and the trusted simulator check using a reviewed interpreter. Report exact observed behavior and failures. Do not declare completion while external checks fail.
6. Write outputs/codex/mission-08-demo-readiness/REPORT.md with source/version, confirmed defects and fixes, exact tests/evidence, browser/mobile status, remaining blockers, next steps and an honest demo-readiness verdict. Record app changes and handoff details in docs/agents as appropriate. Use outputs/claude/mission-08/ for specialist intermediate files if used. Do not fabricate delegation.
7. The coordinator preserves validated changes in this dedicated local runner/<mission-id> feature branch and launches independent review. Do not commit/push/merge or create PRs yourself; publication/deployment is outside this mission. Do not change other worktrees, credentials, existing records or authorization limits.

The mission is scoped to useful safe progress and an honest readiness report; HTTP tests or a test count alone do not establish browser demo readiness. Return the required machine-readable schema with task-scoped status and precise findings.
